verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.twenty.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of the documentation (Getting Started, Welcome, and so on). Doc pages are also served as raw .md URLs, which agents can consume directly. Together these make the docs straightforward to point an agent at. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other expanded agent bundle, no first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs offering, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.
